Northwind Lamp

Northwind Lamp 45.99

The Northwind Lamp is a hand-built desk lamp with a brass arm and a linen shade. It gives a warm reading light and ships in recycled packaging with a ten year warranty on the switch and the socket.

Every lamp is assembled to order in the Porto workshop, tested for a full day on the bench, and signed by the maker before it leaves. The linen shade diffuses the bulb so the light stays soft at any angle.
